name: shinchantw_cbt_week4_first_charge_value_20260803_135956_179295
sql:
/*
D0 cohort only: first-charge product/path segments and completed five-day value.
All users in a segment have a complete D0-D4 observation window.
*/
WITH Cfg AS (SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' ts, DATE '2026-08-02' te, DATE '2026-05-08' ss),
TB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
SA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
M AS (SELECT '新加坡全体' grp,c.u FROM SC c UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',c.u FROM SC c JOIN SA a ON c.u=a.u),
Cohort AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid,MIN(e."#event_time") role_time FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date"=CAST(c.ts AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111') GROUP BY 1,2
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",MIN(e."#event_time") FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ss AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',4,c.ss) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2
),
Pay AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid,e."#event_time" pay_time,CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR) sku,COALESCE(dp."product_id@product_name_tc",CONCAT('商品',CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR))) product_name,TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount AS DOUBLE)/COALESCE(x.exchange,1) amount
 FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x ON e."$part_date"=x.ex_date AND e.pay_currency=x.currency LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_18_0_52801 dp ON TRY_CAST(e.product_id AS INTEGER)=TRY_CAST(dp."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
 WHERE e."$part_event"='charge' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ts AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.te AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111') AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE) AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE)
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",e."#event_time",CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR),COALESCE(dp18."product_id@product_name_tc",dp13."product_id@product_name_tc",CONCAT('商品',CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR))),TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount_usd AS DOUBLE)
 FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_18_0_52801 dp18 ON TRY_CAST(e.product_id AS INTEGER)=TRY_CAST(dp18."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_13_0_20639 dp13 ON TRY_CAST(e.product_id AS INTEGER)=TRY_CAST(dp13."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
 WHERE e."$part_event"='charge' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ss AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.ts,c.te)+4,c.ss) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE) AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE)
),
FirstPay AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT p.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.grp,p.aid ORDER BY p.pay_time) rn FROM Pay p JOIN Cohort c ON p.grp=c.grp AND p.aid=c.aid) WHERE rn=1),
StageBeforeRaw AS (
 SELECT p.grp,p.aid,e."#event_time" et,TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT) stage_id FROM FirstPay p JOIN ta.v_event_18 e ON p.grp='繁体CBT' AND p.aid=e."#account_id" AND e."#event_time"<=p.pay_time WHERE e."#event_name"='stage_fight' AND TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER)=1001
 UNION ALL SELECT p.grp,p.aid,e."#event_time",TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT) FROM FirstPay p JOIN ta.v_event_13 e ON p.grp<>'繁体CBT' AND p.aid=e."#account_id" AND e."#event_time"<=p.pay_time WHERE e."#event_name"='stage_fight' AND TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER)=1001
),
StageBefore AS (SELECT grp,aid,stage_id FROM (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY grp,aid ORDER BY et DESC) rn FROM StageBeforeRaw) WHERE rn=1),
StageName AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT) stage_id,MAX("stage_id@stage_name_show") stage_name FROM ta_dim.dim_18_0_52765 GROUP BY 1,2
 UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT),MAX("stage_id@stage_name_show") FROM ta_dim.dim_13_0_18203 GROUP BY 1,2
 UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡全体',TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT),MAX("stage_id@stage_name_show") FROM ta_dim.dim_13_0_18203 GROUP BY 1,2
),
Login AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid,DATE_DIFF('day',c.ts,CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE)) day_n FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='login' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ts AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.te AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111')
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",DATE_DIFF('day',c.ss,CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE)) FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='login' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ss AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.ts,c.te)+4,c.ss) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL
),
PayValue AS (
 SELECT f.grp,f.aid,COUNT(*) orders,COUNT_IF(p.pay_time>f.pay_time) repeat_orders,SUM(p.amount) ltv5
 FROM FirstPay f JOIN Pay p ON f.grp=p.grp AND f.aid=p.aid GROUP BY 1,2
),
LoginValue AS (
 SELECT f.grp,f.aid,MAX(CASE WHEN l.day_n=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r1,MAX(CASE WHEN l.day_n=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r3,MAX(CASE WHEN l.day_n=4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r4
 FROM FirstPay f LEFT JOIN Login l ON f.grp=l.grp AND f.aid=l.aid GROUP BY 1,2
),
UserValue AS (
 SELECT f.grp,f.aid,f.product_name,DATE_DIFF('minute',CAST(c.role_time AS TIMESTAMP),CAST(f.pay_time AS TIMESTAMP)) mins,COALESCE(s.stage_id,0) stage_id,COALESCE(n.stage_name,'创角后尚未挑战主线') stage_name,
   p.orders,p.repeat_orders,p.ltv5,l.r1,l.r3,l.r4
 FROM FirstPay f JOIN Cohort c ON f.grp=c.grp AND f.aid=c.aid JOIN PayValue p ON f.grp=p.grp AND f.aid=p.aid JOIN LoginValue l ON f.grp=l.grp AND f.aid=l.aid LEFT JOIN StageBefore s ON f.grp=s.grp AND f.aid=s.aid LEFT JOIN StageName n ON f.grp=n.grp AND s.stage_id=n.stage_id
),
Segments AS (
 SELECT grp,'product' segment_type,product_name segment,COUNT(*) users,AVG(ltv5) ltv5,AVG(CASE WHEN repeat_orders>0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) repeat_rate,AVG(r1) r1,AVG(r3) r3,AVG(r4) r4 FROM UserValue GROUP BY 1,2,3
 UNION ALL SELECT grp,'time_bucket',CASE WHEN mins<=10 THEN '01.0-10分钟' WHEN mins<=30 THEN '02.10-30分钟' WHEN mins<=60 THEN '03.30-60分钟' WHEN mins<=120 THEN '04.60-120分钟' ELSE '05.120分钟以上' END,COUNT(*),AVG(ltv5),AVG(CASE WHEN repeat_orders>0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),AVG(r1),AVG(r3),AVG(r4) FROM UserValue GROUP BY 1,2,3
 UNION ALL SELECT grp,'stage',stage_name,COUNT(*),AVG(ltv5),AVG(CASE WHEN repeat_orders>0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),AVG(r1),AVG(r3),AVG(r4) FROM UserValue GROUP BY 1,2,3
 UNION ALL SELECT grp,'product_stage',CONCAT(product_name,'｜',stage_name),COUNT(*),AVG(ltv5),AVG(CASE WHEN repeat_orders>0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),AVG(r1),AVG(r3),AVG(r4) FROM UserValue GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT segment_type AS "segment_type",grp AS "group_name",segment AS "segment",users AS "users",ROUND(ltv5,2) AS "ltv5_usd",ROUND(100*repeat_rate,2) AS "repeat_rate_pct",ROUND(100*r1,2) AS "r1_pct",ROUND(100*r3,2) AS "r3_pct",ROUND(100*r4,2) AS "r4_pct"
FROM Segments WHERE users>=2 ORDER BY 1,2,4 DESC;
